learning_objectives: Apply advanced prompting techniques like Chain-of-Thought, output structuring, and iterative prompting to get better AI results.
outline: Practicing Iterative Prompting for Refined Results

slides.title: Introduction
slides.narration: Sometimes, a basic **prompt** is not enough.
slides.image_prompt: Person looking at a complex AI output, then a lightbulb moment, showing advanced techniques

slides.title: **Chain-of-Thought (CoT)**
slides.image_prompt: Flowchart diagram showing steps, interconnected thoughts, and a question mark leading to an answer

slides.title: **CoT** in Action
slides.narration: This forces the **AI** to show its reasoning.
slides.image_prompt: Person typing on a laptop, a thought bubble above the AI chat window showing gears turning

slides.title: The Apple Problem
content: I have 5 boxes of apples. Each box has 12 apples. I eat 3 apples and give away one full box. How many apples are left? Think step-by-step.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of **ChatGPT** interface with the apple problem prompt typed in the input box

slides.title: **AI**'s Reasoning
slides.narration: Observe how the **AI** breaks down the problem.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of **ChatGPT** output showing the step-by-step calculation for the apple problem

slides.title: Structuring the Output
slides.narration: Next, let's learn to structure the **AI**'s **output**.
slides.image_prompt: Blueprint or architectural drawing icon, symbolizing structured design, with different format icons around it

slides.title: **Markdown** Table Example
content: List the pros and cons of remote work. Provide the output as a Markdown table with two columns: 'Pros' and 'Cons'.
slides.narration: Let's ask for pros and cons of remote work.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of **ChatGPT** interface with the remote work prompt typed, specifying **Markdown** table

slides.title: Formatted **Output**
slides.narration: The **AI** will generate a neat **Markdown** table.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of **ChatGPT** output showing a perfectly formatted **Markdown** table for pros and cons of remote work

slides.title: Other Formats
slides.narration: You can ask for many other formats.
slides.image_prompt: Icons representing different data formats: numbered list, curly braces for **JSON**, angle brackets for **HTML**, comma-separated items

slides.title: Iterative Prompting
slides.image_prompt: Two speech bubbles, one with a question, the other with an answer, and then another question, showing a back-and-forth conversation

slides.title: Refining with Conversation
slides.narration: You refine your **prompts** based on the **AI**'s **output**.
slides.image_prompt: Person looking at **AI** output, then typing a follow-up question, showing thought process

slides.title: Slogan Example
slides.narration: You ask: 'Write a slogan for my new coffee shop.'
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of a **ChatGPT** conversation showing the slogan refinement example, with user and **AI** turns
